context: Kenji helps Ren set up a workspace at home.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: home-office setup; vocabulary (かける/置か/残さ/我が家/以内) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 我が家に、作業机を置きたいんです。
lines.en: I want to put a work desk in my home.
lines.style: engaged young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 机は、窓際に置くといいですよ。
lines.en: It's good to put the desk by the window.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ケーブルは、壁にかけますか?
lines.en: Do I hang the cables on the wall?
lines.style: curious young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、かけておくと、すっきりします。
lines.en: Yes, hanging them keeps it tidy.
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 配線を、残さず束ねたいです。
lines.en: I want to bundle the wiring without leaving any loose.
lines.style: engaged young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一時間以内に、終わりそうですね。
lines.en: It seems we'll finish within an hour.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 我が家が、仕事場になりますね。
lines.style: satisfied young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 物を置く場所を、決めておきましょう。
lines.en: Let's decide where to put things.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
